name: Donkey Active Roadmap - Multigraph Memory First
description: Active backlog for the current Donkey session. Focus on making Multigraph Memory the authoritative memory runtime, exposing real graph-backed observability, and moving retrieval closer to the multigraph memory paper. This supersedes the older Postgreyskull memory direction for today's work.

userStories.title: Add Multigraph Memory stats API for real memory counts
userStories.description: As an operator, I want Multigraph Memory to expose counts for nodes, embeddings, and edges so that status and diagnostics reflect the real backend rather than file heuristics.
acceptanceCriteria: Add graph-level stats proc(s) in src/donkey/adapters/memory/magma_graph.nim for memory, user_profile, preference, entity, embedding, and edge counts
Add adapter-level wrapper(s) in src/donkey/adapters/memory/magma_memory_adapter.nim so runtime code does not query SQL directly
Cover the stats API with PostgreSQL-backed tests
userStories.notes:
Branch: us/us-001-multigraph-memory-stats-api
Status: complete
Files: src/donkey/adapters/memory/magma_graph.nim; src/donkey/adapters/memory/magma_memory_adapter.nim; tests/memory/t_magma_graph.nim; tests/memory/t_magma_memory_adapter.nim
Tests: added PostgreSQL-backed graph stats regression and adapter wrapper stats regression
Validation: nim c -d:withPostgres -r tests/memory/t_magma_graph.nim (pass); nim c -d:withPostgres -r tests/memory/t_magma_memory_adapter.nim (pass); nim c src/donkey.nim (pass); nim c -d:withPostgres src/donkey.nim (pass)
Risks: pre-existing warnings remain outside this story in pgvector_store.nim and one adapter test setup hint
Carry forward: SQL aggregation now lives in MagmaGraph.stats(userId); runtime-facing code should call MagmaMemoryAdapter.stats(UserId) instead of querying counts directly.

userStories.description: As an operator, I want /status and the HTTP status payload to report Multigraph Memory counts so I can verify how much memory is actually stored.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend src/donkey/ports/ipc.nim so DaemonStatus can carry Multigraph Memory stats when PostgreSQL memory is enabled
Populate those fields from the daemon status builder in src/donkey.nim
Update ctl status and /api/status output to show Multigraph Memory node and embedding counts
Add or update tests covering status serialization and user-visible output

userStories.title: Materialize causal edges on the write path
userStories.description: As a system, I want new memories to create real causal edges so Multigraph Memory covers more of the paper than semantic, temporal, and entity links alone.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement causal extraction or inference in the Multigraph Memory write path for appendMemory and related persistence flows
Persist CAUSAL edges in magma_edges for representative cause/effect inputs
Add PostgreSQL-backed tests showing causal edges are created and linked to the right memory nodes

Status: complete

Risks: causal extraction is heuristic and currently limited to markers that imply the new memory is an effect of the previous memory
Carry forward: CAUSAL edges now exist in magma_edges and can be consumed by retrieval scoring in the next story

Teach query policy classification to recognize causal intent in addition to semantic, temporal, and entity intent
Add tests showing causal queries surface the correct memories and score breakdowns

acceptanceCriteria: Refactor query policy and retrieval scoring so semantic, entity, temporal, and causal signals are represented explicitly and coherently
Keep reranking compatible with the richer score breakdown rather than bypassing it

userStories.title: Keep /reset onboarding inside bootstrap without stray provider turns
userStories.description: As an operator, I want /reset to re-arm onboarding cleanly so the bot does not rebuild runtime state or fire a provider completion before the user actually resumes bootstrap.
acceptanceCriteria: After /reset completes, the session remains in onboarding mode until the user makes an explicit bootstrap choice or sends onboarding text
Reset-driven onboarding must not trigger an unintended provider route or free-conversation completion before the user resumes bootstrap
Add regression coverage for reset completion and the first post-reset interaction path

userStories.title: Fix Z.ai provider model picker and empty-state behavior
userStories.description: As a user, I want selecting Zai Coding to show the correct Z.ai model list with buttons, instead of silently landing on the zai-anthropic page with no actionable models.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting Zai Coding in the Telegram model picker opens the intended provider catalog instead of zai-anthropic unless the user explicitly chose that provider
When a provider has models, the picker renders model buttons; when it does not, the UI shows an explicit empty-state explanation instead of a blank keyboard
Add regression coverage for Z.ai provider-to-catalog mapping and Telegram model-picker rendering

userStories.title: Resolve orphaned slash commands that still route as session tasks
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want slash commands like /verbose and /usage to have explicit runtime behavior so they do not fall through to the model as plain user text.
acceptanceCriteria: Decide and implement explicit behavior for /verbose, /exec, /queue, /usage, and /tts, or reroute them away from crSessionTask until they are implemented
Keep core routing, Telegram handling, and command catalog metadata consistent for those commands
Add regressions proving those commands no longer escape to the fallback conversation path
